title: Special Repairs and Civil Maintenance to Lighthouse Tower, Inspection Quarters, Staff Quarter, etc., at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse Station
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender for special repairs and civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, inspection quarters and staff quarters at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Mahabalipuram Lighthouse Station, Mahabalipuram, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Special repairs and civil maintenance to lighthouse tower, inspection quarters, staff quarter etc.

scope.item: Special Repairs and Civil Maintenance to Lighthouse Tower, Inspection Quarters, Staff Quarter, etc.

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; validity three months (table) / 90 days (clause 1.1). EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate, copy to be uploaded and sent by post by closing date. Percentage rate contract.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works with completion certificate; values enhanced at 7% simple per annum; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of buildings or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC structures
PAN card and GST registration; ITR for last three assessment years
Average annual turnover (CA certified) on civil construction/repair works at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025
Proof of experience with completion and performance certificates; key technical personnel for supervision and execution

Tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure III); non-blacklisting affidavit (Annexure IV); relatives declaration (Annexure V); bid security declaration (Annexure VI); Make in India self-certification (Annexure VII)
notes: Scanned Section-I NIT only; no BOQ. Download and bid submission period 17.07.2025 15:00 to 05.08.2025 15:00; opening 06.08.2025 15:00.
